scenarios.title: Validate BH-Cover plan derivation logic and COB archival
gaps: Semantic duplicate: TC_002 and TC_001 share the same business intent of validating BH-Cover plan derivation end to end, differing only by the specific Plan Coverage Description value. TC_002 Description: "Verify that a Michigan Medicaid inbound 834 with Loop 2320 COB02 set to BH-Cover and REF*ZZ*BH-Cover derives the HMP behavioral health plan from the combination of Plan Coverage Description MHPCMCFMAHMPMC, CSHCS indicator, and member eligibility type BH, and persists the transaction through archive, TM UI, EDIStageArchive, and Facets." TC_001 Description: "Verify that a Michigan Medicaid inbound 834 with Loop 2320 COB02 set to BH-Cover and REF*ZZ*BH-Cover derives the member behavioral health plan from the combination of Plan Coverage Description MHPCMCFMAMC, CSHCS indicator, and member eligibility type BH, and loads the transaction through staging, archive, TM UI, EDIStageArchive, and Facets."

Semantic duplicate: TC_003 is a standalone observability/archive case already covered by TC_004. TC_003 Description: "Verify that when one Michigan Medicaid inbound 834 file contains at least five repeated Loop 2320 BH-Cover COB segments, every received COB loop is archived to EDIStageArchive.dbo.MemberCOB for the processed interchange." TC_004 Description: "Verify that one Michigan Medicaid daily inbound 834 containing five repeated Loop 2320 BH-Cover COB occurrences for the same member preserves each occurrence as a separate archived COB record and does not drop any repeated BH-Cover loop during staging, processing, canonical generation, or archive loading."

scenarios.title: Validate 001/33 processing updates existing members and creates new members

flagged.why: wrong member field for SSN update

gaps: Test Step Description field: "a new member SSN in NM109-associated member data for this execution" contradicts hint "Member eligibility begin = Loop 2000 DTP*348. ... Plan Coverage Description = Loop 2300 HD04. Never name a date by a bare element position such as DTP01, DTP02 or DTP03." and scenario text "SSN" as a demographic field; also Expected Result field: "the row contains the new SSN" together with Step Description "NM1*IL carrying the existing member identifier values, a new member SSN in NM109-associated member data" is inconsistent with member SSN being separate from NM109/member identifier usage in the table batch.

TC_007 is most closely related, but scenario description requires "9) New member received with 001/33 creates a new member record in Facets and populates SBEL, SBSG, SBSB, MEME, SBAD, SBCS, MEPR, MECM, MECD, MEIA, MEST, and MELC." The table has no dedicated test case for the separate listed condition beyond the other new-member case family; add a dedicated test case for it.

Step Description field: "SELECT MEME.MEME_SSN, MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME, MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME, MEME.MEME_MID_NAME, MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT, MEME.MEME_SEX, MEME.SBSB_CK FROM FACPRDDB.dbo.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME WITH (NOLOCK)" conflicts with other table usage of member-name columns such as "SELECT MEME_SSN, MEME_FST_NM, MEME_LST_NM, MEME_MID_NM, MEME_SEX, MEME_BIRTH_DT, SBSB_CK FROM FACPRDDB.dbo.CMC_MEME_MEMBER" in TC_001.

Step Description field: "SELECT COUNT(*) AS RowCount FROM FACPRDDB.dbo.CMC_SBSG_SUB_GROUP WITH (NOLOCK)" conflicts with scenario acceptance criteria table name "SBSG" and with other table text "CMC_SBSG_SUBGROUP" in TC_007; Step Description field: "SELECT COUNT(*) AS RowCount FROM FACPRDDB.dbo.CMC_SBCS_CONTRACT_SPAN WITH (NOLOCK)" conflicts with other table text "CMC_SBCS_COVERAGE" in TC_007; Step Description field: "SELECT COUNT(*) AS RowCount FROM FACPRDDB.dbo.CMC_MEPR_PERSON WITH (NOLOCK)", "CMC_MECM_CONTACT_METHOD", "CMC_MECD_COUNTY_DATA", "CMC_MEIA_IDENTIFIERS", "CMC_MEST_STATUS", "CMC_MELC_LIFESTYLE" conflicts with scenario acceptance criteria list "MEPR MECM MECD MEIA MEST MELC" and other table text in TC_007: "CMC_MEPR_PROVIDER", "CMC_MECM_COND_MAINT", "CMC_MECD_DIAGNOSIS", "CMC_MEIA_IDCARD_ARCH", "CMC_MEST_SPCL_TY", "CMC_MELC_LSTY_CD".

scenarios.title: Validate new-member BH derived-date matrix for pre- and post-10/01/2026 starts
gaps: Semantic duplicate: TC_001 and TC_003 share the same business intent of validating a new member split from non-BH to BH for pre-10/01/2026 dates. Evidence in Test Case Name/Description: TC_001 "Verify new Michigan Medicaid member splits from non-behavioral coverage on 06/01/2026 to behavioral health coverage on 10/01/2026 with no term event when member eligibility begins before 10/01/2026" and TC_003 "Verify new Michigan Medicaid member splits from non-behavioral coverage on 06/01/2026 to behavioral health coverage on 10/01/2026 when both member eligibility and behavioral health coverage begin before 10/01/2026".

Semantic duplicate: TC_003 and TC_001 share the same business intent of validating a new member split from non-BH to BH for pre-10/01/2026 dates. Evidence in Test Case Name/Description: TC_003 "Verify new Michigan Medicaid member splits from non-behavioral coverage on 06/01/2026 to behavioral health coverage on 10/01/2026 when both member eligibility and behavioral health coverage begin before 10/01/2026" and TC_001 "Verify new Michigan Medicaid member splits from non-behavioral coverage on 06/01/2026 to behavioral health coverage on 10/01/2026 with no term event when member eligibility begins before 10/01/2026".

scenarios.title: Validate existing-member BH addition matrix and first-of-month effective-date normalization
gaps: Step Description field quotes non-authoritative COB fields: "SELECT * FROM EDIStageArchive.dbo.MemberCOB WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE InterchangeID = [TEST DATA: InterchangeID for 5790.260812.0710.04lq0q9t] AND COBCode = 'B' AND MutuallyDefinedId = 'BH-Cover' AND COBBeginDate = '2026-11-01' AND COBEndDate IS NULL;"; contradicts domain hint line: "BH indicator = Loop 2320 COB02 = \"BH-Cover\", accompanied by REF*ZZ*BH-Cover. BH coverage start = Loop 2320 DTP*344. BH coverage end/term = Loop 2320 DTP*345."

Most closely related to TC_006, scenario description requires: "6) Existing member demographic update on 001/33 does not update eligibility dates based on the Member eligibility begin from the 001 transaction." and also states "Validate that for an existing Facets member receiving BH-Cover in a change file, demographics are updated, the existing non-BH span is recalculated into non-BH and BH spans per the four update matrix combinations, eligibility itself is not rewritten from the 001 transaction"; TC_006 only validates demographics and unchanged eligibility date, but has no quoted step or expected result validating any "BH-Cover" processing or resulting coverage/span outcome. Add a dedicated BH-Cover coverage/span validation to this test case.
